title: batest manifest.json (v2)
description: Lightweight, redundant summary of a .batest test set, as described in SPEC.md.

formatVersion.description: Container/schema version. Starts at 1; v2 (this schema) uses 2.

createdWith.description: Application name and version that produced the file.

comparisonCategory.$comment: Resolved, human-readable value; if 'others' was selected, the free-text value is substituted in directly. TODO: the full canonical list of comparison category values (COMPARISON_CATEGORIES) is not enumerated in the source specification, so this is intentionally left as an open string rather than a guessed enum.

models.description: Distinct manufacturer/model combinations used across all tracks in all of the test set's test[] objects, deduplicated. Empty array if the test set has no manufacturer/model data.
